diagnosis: Check C4, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF2 (prohibiting model training), passed in all rollouts despite the models only having access to shared facts S1-S3. The models consistently set 'customer_content_training_permitted' to false, likely due to a generic safety/privacy heuristic or pattern-matching for enterprise compliance, making the hidden information in PF2 redundant.

C4.why: The standard privacy template permits ordinary product-improvement use and does not set the partner's timing, while PF2 changes the terms to prohibit model training and require deletion exactly 30 days after termination.
